description: A script for managing GitHub pull requests and issues, assigning maintainers, labels, and reviewers based on project areas and maintainers configuration.

classes.name: Maintainers
classes.description: Class for managing maintainers and areas configuration, imported from get_maintainer module.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages if verbose level is greater than 0.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for operation parameters.

methods.name: process_pr
methods.description: Processes a pull request: assigns maintainers, labels, reviewers based on changed files and areas.

methods.name: process_issue
methods.description: Processes an issue: assigns maintainers based on labels.

methods.name: process_modules
methods.description: Processes modules in the project, assigning maintainers to open PRs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, initializes GitHub connection and calls processing functions based on arguments.
